project.name: Student Management Microservices (Asynchronous, CQRS Pattern, Kafka)
project.description: Four independent Spring Boot microservices (student, course, enrollment, notification), each owning its own MySQL database. Each service's primary aggregate (Student/Course/Enrollment/Notification) is split into a command side (writes) and a query side (reads from a separate, denormalized table), kept in sync via Kafka projection events — CQRS with eventual consistency. All cross-service communication (the enrollment saga) is also asynchronous over Kafka. A shared-secret JWT, issued by student-service and validated independently by all four services, provides single sign-on without a gateway.
